canonical_project: Hickory Data Centres Truganina hyperscale facility
notes: Local/trade reporting says Hickory broke ground on a Truganina hyperscale facility designed as two 36MW buildings with 18 data halls and availability originally targeted for Q4 2022. Baxtel notes the Hickory 72MW Melbourne project in its Melbourne market timeline; treated as operational based on elapsed build window, but public operator/tenant details remain limited.
